REGIONAL REGULATION OF SITUBONDO REGENCY

NUMBER 19 OF 2015

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

n

VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD THE REGENT OF SITUBONDO,

n

Considering a. b. c. d. that until now the number of violence against women and children in Situbondo Regency is still high, while services and protection have not been carried out optimally; that in order for protection efforts for women and children to obtain optimal results, concrete actions from the regional government are needed and broad community participation needs to be increased; that to realize the provision of protection for women and children and to provide legal certainty in the implementation of protection for women and children in Situbondo Regency, the implementation of protection for women and children needs to be regulated in a Regional Regulation; that based on the considerations as referred to in letters a, b, and c, it is necessary to stipulate a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children.

heading: Article 1
text:
Pasal 1

Pemerintah Daerah adalah Pemerintah Kabupaten Situbondo.

Bupati adalah Bupati Situbondo.

Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 tahun, termasuk yang ada dalam kandungan. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan secara melawan hukum dengan atau tanpa menggunakan sarana terhadap fisik dan psikis yang menimbulkan bahaya bagi nyawa, badan atau menimbulkan terampasnya kemerdekaan seseorang.

Kekerasan terhadap perempuan adalah setiap tindakan yang berakibat atau mungkin berakibat kesengsaraan atau penderitaan perempuan secara fisik, seksual atau psikologis, termasuk ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara sewenang-wen&rg, baik yang terjadi di ranah publik atau dalam kehidupan pribadi.

Kekerasan terhadap anak adalah setiap perbuatan terhadap anak yang berakibat timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fisik, mental, seksual, psikologis, termasuk penelantaran dan perlakuan buruk yang menganc€un integritas tubuh dan merendahkan martabat anak yang dilakukan oleh pihak-pihak yang seharusnya bertanggungjawab atas nakal tersebut atau mereka yang memiliki kuasa atas anak tersebut, yang seharusnya dapat dipercaya, misalnya orang tua, keluarga dekat, guru dan pendamping.

Korban adalah perempuan dan anak yang mengalami kesengsaraan dan/atau penderitaan baik langsung maupun tidak langsung sebagai akibat dari kekerasan.

Pelayanan adalah tindakan yang harus segera dilakukan kepada korban ketika melihat, mendengar dan mengetahui akan, sedang atau telah terjadinya kekerasan terhadap korban.

Pendamping adalah orang atau perwakilan dari lembaga yang mempunyai keahlian melakukan pendampingan korban untuk melakukan konseling, d

translated_text:
Article 1

Regional Government is the Situbondo Regency Government.

Regent is the Situbondo Regent.

Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including those in the womb. Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Violence against women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.

Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child committed by parties who should be responsible for the child or those who have power over the child, who should be trusted, such as parents, close family, teachers and companions.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.

Service is an action that must be immediately taken for the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing about, during or after the occurrence of violence against the victim.

Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has expertise in accompanying victims to conduct counseling, d

-t t l,t,t

:l: n n d therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

10. Integrated Service Center (PPT) for Victims of Violence against Women and Children of Situbondo Regency, hereinafter referred to as PPT Situbondo Regency is an institution providing services to victims of violence, which is hospital-based, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psycho-social and legal services.

1 1. Safe house (shelter) is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with specified operational standards.

L2. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

13. Woman is a person who is of female gender.

L4. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and his children, and mother and her children.

15. Household is family members and relatives such as grandchildren, nieces/nephews, older siblings, younger siblings, grandfather, grandmother, husband, wife, cousins and so forth and non-relatives such as domestic workers, drivers and so forth who live and reside in one house.

16. Agency for Community and Women Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as BPMP is the Agency for Community and Women Empowerment of Situbondo Regency.

(1) Forms of services for victims of violence organized by PPT include:

a. medical services in the form of care and recovery of physical condition carried out by medical and paramedical personnel;
b. medicolegal services which are a form of medical $ d l-- a t.i I-l n service for the purposes of evidence in the legal field; legal aid services to assist victims of violence in c. undergoing the judicial process; first psychosocial aid to victims is conducted to d. identify the occurrence of violence and trauma experienced by victims; assistance for victims of violence carried out by e. competent persons or institutions who have expertise in conducting counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence and have cooperated with PPT; and

I. UMUM

Penyelenggaraan perlindungan terhadap korban kekerasan diselenggarakan berdasarkan pada prinsip kemanusiaan, keterpaduan dan keadilan. Sehingga setiap orang harus mendapatkan haknya atas perlindungan terhadap rasa aman serta terbebas dari penyiksaan atau n perlakuan yang merendahkan derajat martabat manusia yang bertentangan dengan apa yang dicita-citakan dalam Pembukaan Undang Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun L945 yaitu terciptanya kemanusiaan yang adil dan beradab. Untuk mencapai layanan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan secara terpadu dan komprehensip diperlukan bentuk layanan secara terpadu dari berbagai lembaga terkait meliputi pelayanan medis, mediocolegal, psikososial, ' bantuan hukum, pendampingan, kemandirian ekonomi (pelatihan). Layanan tersebut dilakukan secara merata ke seluruh lapisan masyarakat sehingga setiap warga negara berhak memperoleh kesempatan yang sama untuk mendapatkan keamanan dan perlindungan secara hukum.

Secara prinsip, sasaran strategis penyelenggaraan perlindungan n ailalah menjaga keberlanjutan perlindungan melalui upaya layanan terpadu, komprehensif dan rumah aman dan nyaman yang kondusif untuk korban kekerasan. Sasaran strategis tersebut ditempuh melalui tahapan-tahapan yang saling terkait, baik perencanaan, perlindungan, layanan dan pembiayaan, pengawasan serta sanksi.

Ada empat fenomena penting yang perlu dicermati dalam kaitan

, dengan Penyelengga.raan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan. Pertama, adalah kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak dari tahun ketahun jumlahnya meningkat dengan modus kekerasannya cenderung lebih sadis (pelaku yang menggorok leher, menyiram dengan air panas, menceburkan ke dalam sumur, sampai mematahkan sebagian apggota badan dan seterusnya) . Kedua, banyaknya kasus kekerasan terhadap Pekerja Rumah Tangga (PRT) yang didominasi oleh kaum perempuan yang terjadi akhir-akhir ini membutuhkan perhatian dari semua pihak terlebih adanya perlindungan hukum, peraturan dan kebijakan yang melindungi mereka. Ketiga, minimnya sarana dan

\ld t a

,t a prasarana rumah aman dan nyaman yang kondusif untuk korban kekerasan. Ketiga fenomena tersebut mengindikasikan semakin meningkatnya kompleksitas perilaku kekerasan yang korbannya adalah didominasi perempuan dan anak baik yang menjadi pekerja rumah tangga maupun yang selainnya. Keempat, anak adalah amanah dan karunia T\rhan Yang Maha Esa, dalam dirinya melekat harkat dan martabat sebagai manusia seutuhnya. Anak adalah generasi penerus cita-cita perjuangan bangsa yang memiliki peran strategis, dan mempunyai ciri dan sifat khusus yang diharapkan dapat menjamin kelangsungan eksistensi bangsa dan negara di masa depan. Anak perlu mendapat kesempatan seluas-luasnya untuk tumbuh dan berkembang secara optimal, baik secara fisik, mental, kognitif, spiritual maupun sosial.

Karena sifatnya, maka tumbuh kembang anak harus dilakukan dalam linglmngan yang melindungi dari segala bahaya dalam bentuk pengasuhan yang optimal. n

Oleh karena itu, diperlukan payung hukum berupa Peraturan

Daerah yang mampu mengakomodir semua isu terkait penyelenggaraan perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan, mampu memberikan layanan terpadu secara holistik dan komprehensif, dan secara tegas memberikan mandat kepada lembaga untuk melakukan koordinasi kebijakan dan pengawasan, dan mandat kepada lembaga untuk memberikan layanan. Selain itu, Perda juga dapat membuka keterlibatan institusi non pemerintah dan masyarakat untuk berperan secara luas.

Penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban kbkerasan di Kabupaten Situbondo dilakukan berdasarkan Peraturan Bupati Situbondo Nomor 6 Tahun 2006 tentang Penyelenggaraan n Perlindungan Korban Tindak Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak dan Keputusan Bupati Situbondo No. 188/ 237 1P.00 L.2 /2OO7 tentang hrsat Pelayanan Terpadu (PPT) Korban Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak di Kabupaten Situbondo. Sebagaimana fenomena yang dikemukakan di atas, Peraturan Bupati Nomor 6 Tahun 2006 tersebut belum mampu mampu menjadi payung hukum yang komprehensif dalam memberikan perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan. Dengan adanya Peraturan Daerah ini diharapkan dapat mengantisipasi dan menanggulangi kondisi kekerasan yang terjadi di Kabupaten Situbondo, sehingga dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pelayanan terhadap korban kekerasan secara terpadu dan komprehensif.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The implementation of protection for victims of violence is conducted based on the principles of humanity, integration and justice. Therefore, every person must receive their right to protection for a sense of security and freedom from torture or n treatment that degrades human dignity which is contrary to what is aspired to in the Preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, namely the creation of just and civilized humanity. To achieve integrated and comprehensive services for the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence, an integrated form of service from various related institutions is required, including medical services, medicolegal, psychosocial, ' legal assistance, assistance, economic independence (training). These services are carried out evenly across all levels of society so that every citizen has the right to obtain equal opportunities to receive security and legal protection.

In principle, the strategic objective of implementing protection n is to maintain the sustainability of protection through integrated, comprehensive services and a safe and comfortable shelter that is conducive for victims of violence. These strategic objectives are pursued through interrelated stages, including planning, protection, services and financing, supervision and sanctions.

There are four important phenomena that need to be observed in relation

, to the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence. First, is violence against women and children which is increasing in number from year to year with the mode of violence tending to be more sadistic (perpetrators who slit throats, pour hot water, throw into wells, to breaking some body parts and so on). Second, the many cases of violence against Domestic Workers (PRT) which are dominated by women that have occurred recently require attention from all parties, especially the existence of legal protection, regulations and policies that protect them. Third, the lack of facilities and

\ld t a

,t a infrastructure for safe and comfortable shelters that are conducive for victims of violence. These three phenomena indicate the increasing complexity of violent behavior whose victims are dominated by women and children, both those who become domestic workers and others. Fourth, children are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in them is inherent dignity and worth as complete human beings. Children are the next generation of the nation's ideals who have a strategic role, and have special characteristics and traits that are expected to ensure the continuity of the existence of the nation and state in the future. Children need to get the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, cognitively, spiritually and socially.

Because of its nature, the growth and development of children must be carried out in an environment that protects them from all dangers in the form of optimal care. n

Therefore, a legal umbrella in the form of a Regional Regulation is needed that is capable of accommodating all issues related to the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence, capable of providing integrated services in a holistic and comprehensive manner, and firmly giving a mandate to institutions to coordinate policies and supervision, and a mandate to institutions to provide services. In addition, Regional Regulations can also open the involvement of non-governmental institutions and the community to play a broad role.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in Situbondo Regency is carried out based on Situbondo Regent Regulation Number 6 of 2006 concerning the Implementation of n Protection for Victims of Acts of Violence against Women and Children and Situbondo Regent Decree No. 188/ 237 1P.00 L.2 /2OO7 concerning the Integrated Service Center (PPT) for Victims of Violence against Women and Children in Situbondo Regency. As the phenomena mentioned above, Regent Regulation Number 6 of 2006 has not been able to become a comprehensive legal umbrella in providing protection for women and children victims of violence. With the existence of this Regional Regulation, it is hoped that it can anticipate and overcome the conditions of violence that occur in Situbondo Regency, so that it can provide protection and services to victims of violence in an integrated and comprehensive manner.

Article 2

Letter aWhat is meant by "the principle of respect for human rights" is that the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is to ensure the fulfillment of the rights of victims of violence as a manifestation of respect for human rights.

Letter b What is meant by "the principle of gender equality and justice" is a process of equality and conditions for men and women to obtain equal opportunities and their rights as human beings, so that they are able to play a role and

. participate in political, economic, socio-cultural, defense and national security activities and equality in enjoying the results of such development.

Letter c What is meant by "the principle of protection of victims' rights" is the protection of the personal self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, a sense of security and protection from threats of fear, freedom from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity.

Letter e What is meant by "the principle of the best interests of the victim" is that all actions concerning victims carried out by the government, community, legislative bodies and judicial bodies, the best interests of the victim must be the primary consideration.

translated_text:
Article 3

" Paragraph (1)What is meant by gender-based violence is actions based on gender relations that place women in a subordinate position to men.

Paragraph (2) Point aWhat is meant by "physical violence" is an act that causes pain, illness, or serious injury such as slapping, hitting, spitting, i

I jfI a n

L7 pulling hair/yanking, kicking, burning with hot objects, hitting/injuring with weapons, and/or causing disability to someone's body, miscarriage, fainting and/or causing death.

Point bWhat is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness, and/or severe psychological suffering to a person. Psychological violence can take the form of emotional abuse such as insults, hurtful comments or belittling of self-esteem, isolating the wife from the outside world, threatening or intimidating as a means of imposing one's will.

Point c What is meant by "sexual violence" is violence against sexuality which includes isolating (distancing) the wife from her emotional needs, forcing sexual intercourse, forcing one's own sexual desires or disregarding the wife's satisfaction. Sexual violence can also take the form of coerced sexual intercourse committed against persons ' residing within the household, coercion of sexual intercourse against one person within the household with others for commercial purposes and / or certain purposes.

Hurr,rf d What is meant by "economic neglect" is neglecting the economic needs of the wife or children or family members and relatives such as not providing maintenance to the wife, even spending the wife's money, not providing or withholding wages of domestic workers or drivers and including acts of limiting and/or prohibiting family members from working in a proper manner.

Point e What is meant by "restriction of movement" is limiting the movement of the wife or children in developing their potential for both economic and social purposes such as prohibiting gathering and socializing in the community as well as restricting the movement of relatives such as preventing domestic workers
